title: The direct image of a quasi-coherent module along a closed immersion is locally a cokernel of quasi-coherent modules
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the direct image of a quasi-coherent module along a closed immersion is locally the cokernel of a map of quasi-coherent modules on the ambient space (author lemma at source lines 2096-2103, label lemma-i-star-quasi-coherent). The proof (source lines 2105-2113) takes a local cokernel presentation of the module by direct sums of copies of the structure sheaf of the closed subspace, uses that such direct sums remain quasi-coherent and that the direct image functor commutes with colimits, and transports the presentation to the ambient space, the author recording that the remaining details are omitted (proof lines 2109-2112). The transport of the local presentation along the direct image is the content. H2.
